notes.title: Do Not Miss Our Livestream Next Friday, October 1st at 7:15pm CET!
notes.content:
Hello snails,

We are participating in the Steam Next Fest with our very own demo and livestream! Our stream will start [b]Friday, October 1st at 7:15pm CET/10:15am PT.[/b] Join us while we unveil new details and curious facts about the world of Clid The Snail.

[h3]Set a reminder to make sure you don´t miss the stream![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597580/Clid_The_Snail/

[b]The demo will be available until October 7th[/b], so make sure you play before it´s too late!

Keep snailing it,
The Weird Beluga Team
